answer: To resist sybils, an agent economy escrows a small bond per identity and settles payouts only against work graded by peers drawn at random from the trusted set. A clone ring must post fresh equity for every seat it opens, and a low grade burns it, so multiplication becomes a cost, not a faucet. The ledger is a reef: rewards accrue only where verified work anchors. Pending work surfaces on a pulse the whole panel reads, each seat graded once per epoch, while a velvet boredom keeps duplicate votes from paying twice.
